name: Scene
brief: Scene class for hierarchical grouping of Paint objects

members.name: add
members.brief: Add a paint to the scene

members.name: remove
members.brief: Remove paint(s) from the scene If no paint is provided, removes all paints

members.name: clear
members.brief: Clear all paints from the scene (alias for remove())

members.name: resetEffects
members.brief: Reset all previously applied scene effects, restoring the scene to its original state.
members.returns: The Scene instance for method chaining

members.name: gaussianBlur
members.signature: gaussianBlur(sigma: number, direction: number = 0, border: number = 0, quality: number = 75): this
members.brief: Apply a Gaussian blur effect to the scene.
members.returns: The Scene instance for method chaining

members.name: dropShadow
members.signature: dropShadow(r: number, g: number, b: number, a: number, angle: number, distance: number, sigma: number, quality: number = 60): this
members.brief: Apply a drop shadow effect with Gaussian blur filter to the scene.
members.returns: The Scene instance for method chaining

members.name: fillEffect
members.signature: fillEffect(r: number, g: number, b: number, a: number): this
members.brief: Override the scene content color with a given fill color.
members.returns: The Scene instance for method chaining

members.name: tint
members.signature: tint(blackR: number, blackG: number, blackB: number, whiteR: number, whiteG: number, whiteB: number, intensity: number): this
members.brief: Apply a tint effect to the scene using black and white color parameters.
members.returns: The Scene instance for method chaining

members.name: tritone
members.signature: tritone(shadowR: number, shadowG: number, shadowB: number, midtoneR: number, midtoneG: number, midtoneB: number, highlightR: number, highlightG: number, highlightB: number, blend: number): this
members.brief: Apply a tritone color effect to the scene using three color parameters for shadows, midtones, and highlights. A blending factor determines the mix between the original color and the tritone colors.
members.returns: The Scene instance for method chaining
